requirement: The system shall provide a browser-based application through which users can request and view the stored mood information for a song.

The system shall use Elasticsearch as the authoritative store for song records and already available song-mood associations, and retrieve those associations for later lookup requests. Song records shall include the song name, link, lyrics, and language; where artist metadata is used, it shall include the artist name, genres, and song count. The project dataset shall be limited to English songs.
When a requested song is not found in Elasticsearch, the system shall search for it using the external Genius API and return the search result or an explicit search-failure response.
The system shall provide a Kibana interface through which operators or data inspectors can view the song records and mood associations stored in Elasticsearch.
The system shall deploy its React frontend, FastAPI backend, Elasticsearch store, and Kibana inspection interface as separate Docker services communicating over the configured application network.
